hooks.command: git fetch origin --quiet 2>/dev/null || true; new=$(git log HEAD..origin/main --oneline --no-decorate -20 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$new" ]; then echo '[team-updates] New commits on origin/main not in your local HEAD:'; echo "$new"; docs=$(git diff --name-only HEAD...origin/main -- docs/ 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$docs" ]; then echo '--- docs changed (read these to catch up on team decisions) ---'; echo "$docs"; fi; echo '--- all files ---'; git diff --stat HEAD...origin/main 2>/dev/null | tail -8; fi
